title: Croatia Under Pressure: Toxic Waste Scandal and Stubborn Inflation Test… · 10 Sep
keywords: Croatia, toxic waste, Zagreb protest, inflation, energy prices, environmental governance, EU, Croatian government, cost of living, hazardous waste, eurozone, public trust, rule of law
notes: Tens of thousands of Croatians took to the streets of Zagreb to demand action over an illegal hazardous-waste dump exceeding 30,000 tons, as the government faces simultaneous criticism over inflation that remains above the euro-area average. The twin crises are straining public confidence in state institutions and raising questions about Croatia's environmental and economic governance within the European Union. Together, they tell a single story: citizens are questioning whether their government can protect both their environment and their wallets.
